findings.why_it_matters: Heading levels are one level too high for this clause: the sibling clauses are transcribed with 3.10 and 3.12 (THE DATA-NAME CLAUSE) at '##'/'###' and their numbered subsections one level deeper (3.12.1 Function at '###'), but 3.11 is an H1 and its subsections H2. 3.11 thus outranks the chapter structure it belongs to, which breaks outline/section navigation and any tool that slices clauses by heading depth.
